headline: US Moves to Bar Chinese Telecom Operators from Direct Access to Phone Numbers
summary: The United States is planning to prohibit Chinese telecommunications firms from having direct access to US telephone numbers, expanding restrictions on Chinese state-linked telecom infrastructure.
why: Washington has systematically restricted Chinese telecommunications providers over national security and espionage concerns, affecting global telecoms routing and carrier partnerships.

impacts.name: Telecommunications
impacts.why: Chinese telecom operators face further operational curtailment and revenue loss in North American corridors.
